The agency contemplates using this approach only for the short term. The setting of AFES's for nonpassenger automobiles of 6,000 pounds and less GVWR for more than a single MY would increase the number of model years in which the standards must be set more conservatively than they would be if the nonpassenger automobiles of 6,000 pounds GVWR were also regulated.

The environmental impact of this alternative would be that total greater beneficial and adverse impacts would be reported for this action but less than would be reported if, at a later date an AFES's requiring a higher level of fuel economy were established. Since the goal of the AFES is to result in net beneficial environmental impacts in the form of energy savings, setting AFES for model years after 1979 at a later date will result in more energy savings.
